crew_github_app_converting: Setting up the app on the crew server...
crew_github_app_create_hint: Opens GitHub in your browser. Sign in there, check the app and click Create GitHub App.
crew_github_app_deadline_note: GitHub's one-time code is valid for 1 hour. Atlas exchanges it the moment it arrives, so only the crew server keeps the key.
crew_github_app_installations_error: GitHub could not be asked just now: {detail}
crew_github_app_installing: Waiting for the installation on GitHub. This updates by itself.
crew_github_app_intro: The crew gets its own GitHub identity: an app that reaches only the repositories you pick, with short-lived tokens that never leave {server}.
crew_github_app_load_failed: Could not read the GitHub App from the crew server: {detail}
crew_github_app_not_installed: Not installed yet: the crew cannot reach any repository.
crew_github_app_org_invalid: Use the organization's GitHub login: letters, digits and hyphens, up to 39.
crew_github_app_remove_description: The crew server forgets the app's key and stops using it, and falls back to its GitHub login. The app itself stays on GitHub: delete it there to revoke it completely.
crew_github_app_simple_description: The crew server signs in with the gh login you connect in the crew workspace. Quick, but the crew then acts as that account.
crew_github_app_timed_out: GitHub did not answer in {minutes} minutes. Nothing was created. Start again when you are ready.
crew_github_app_waiting_body: Confirm the app on GitHub in your browser. Atlas hears GitHub's answer on this computer only.
crew_github_app_webhook_bad_https: Use an https:// address, since GitHub's events cross the internet.
crew_github_app_webhook_bad_url: Use a web address with a host and nothing after the path: no user name, password, query or #.
crew_github_app_webhook_failing: Deliveries are failing, so the crew is polling again until GitHub reaches this address.
crew_github_app_webhook_hint: By default the crew asks GitHub for new events every 2 minutes. With a public HTTPS address that forwards to this server, GitHub delivers each one at once. Atlas never opens the server to the internet: put your own reverse proxy, Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailscale Funnel in front of it.
crew_github_app_webhook_live: On: GitHub delivers events at once.
crew_github_app_webhook_off: Off: GitHub events arrive within 2 minutes.
crew_github_app_webhook_pending: Waiting for GitHub's first signed delivery. Until then the crew keeps polling.
crew_github_app_webhook_too_long: Use an address of at most 200 characters.
crew_github_app_webhook_unsynced: GitHub has not been given this address yet. The crew server keeps trying.
crew_github_app_workflows_reason: Changing .github/workflows needs GitHub's separate Workflows permission. Leave it off unless the crew should edit CI files.
